_doc: Shared weapon afterimages, hit sparks and Weapon.img sounds. Bowman bows/crossbows and arrows belong to bowman.json (#199); Thief claws/daggers and throwing stars belong to thief.json (#207); Pirate knuckles/guns and bullets belong to pirate.json (#186). Afterimages stay shared. Potion steps beyond the three card gates (#229, spec #225, potions.schedule): Unagi 2022003, Pure Water 2022000, Ice Cream Pop 2001001 and Red Bean Sundae 2001002, each with its Item.wz/Consume entry (icon, recovery spec) and Sound.wz/Item.img Use sound; their names are in String.wz/Consume.img, which asset_manifest.json imports whole. Orange, White and Mana Elixir and their sounds stay in asset_manifest.json.
